boundary: This is a post-build x1 validation overlay. It does not rewrite the planning-time Method Flow receipt, create completion credit, install a package, or establish certification or authority.

rows.bounded_passing_witness: The exact installed Ruff 0.16.4 module was invoked through the current Python interpreter and the same two x1 files passed the selected fatal and undefined-name rules.
rows.failed_witness: The first bounded lint command invoked a bare ruff shim from a non-profile PowerShell process; the command was not resolvable and produced no lint result.
rows.recurrence_guard: When a verified Python tool lacks a directly resolvable shim, use the exact current interpreter with python -m before considering any installation or profile mutation.
rows.rollback: No package, profile, repository artifact, or global state was changed by the failed command or bounded recovery.
